note: Flags + titles + prompts verified verbatim against the official NZCSC24_R0_writeup.pdf (Wayback). Points/difficulty + solve notes from the owner's 2024 sheet.

challenges.title: Robots
challenges.method: robots.txt reveals a disallowed path leading to the flag.

challenges.title: RCVS Exploit
challenges.method: The flag is hidden in the page source / inspect element.

challenges.title: Traversal Troubles
challenges.method: Directory traversal via the ?file= parameter (../../../../flag.txt).

challenges.title: Hidden Flag
challenges.method: Whitespace characters encode binary; pad and decode to ASCII.
challenges.prompt: The flag is securely nestled within the labyrinth. Only those with advanced skills and a tenacious determination can extract it, a testament to the intricate dance of technology and the exhilaration of unravelling digital mysteries that draws hackers into the depths of cyberspace.

challenges.title: Interjection
challenges.method: Time-based blind SQL injection.
challenges.prompt: We created a honeypot database but accidentally put a production flag in it! Luckily, we had Endace hardware running a 100 Gbps packet capture when the attacker hit it and we didn't drop a single packet. Find out what the attacker stole.

challenges.title: Behind the Scenes
challenges.method: Debug the executable in WinDBG; at the automatic breakpoint read the flag bytes from memory, hex > base64 > strip null bytes.
challenges.prompt: What are all those random bytes and what do they do? Note: The executable is safe to run.

challenges.title: Burren Waffet's Last Hurrah
challenges.method: For each number, print 1 if the next is larger else 0; binary > ASCII.
challenges.prompt: Burren Waffet has thrown in the investment towel, but we believe he's left bits of information in the chart we found on his computer.

challenges.title: Flag Trader
challenges.method: OSINT: Trade Me auction > seller stagflealer420 > Twitter > reconstruct a git repo to find the user > bash history > unlock the ZIP.
challenges.prompt: We found someone was obtaining NZCSC flags illegally so we set up a honeypot to catch them out. Can you figure out who is trying to get flags and what they're up to? The TradeMe auction ID is 4717209839.

challenges.title: RAM > Disk
challenges.method: Memory dump; Volatility shows the bash commands that were executed (possible malware).
challenges.prompt: I was just installing some software on my new OS but I've done something bad, things freeze up when I try basic commands. I've taken a memory dump, investigate.

challenges.title: rm -rf
challenges.method: Reconstruct the RAID array, find the file containing the message about strings, decode base64; the URL no longer exists so use the Wayback Machine.
challenges.prompt: He deleted his website, deleted all files referencing it, and deleted one of his hard-drives with a hammer. Why bother.

challenges.title: Sharp Snake
challenges.method: Malware > dotPeek > find the .dll; the DLL runs the hacks section as a zip; take the hash of the zip plus the debug value to decrypt main.
challenges.prompt: We found some malware that "pops calc.exe" ... can you reverse it and figure out how it works?

challenges.title: Substitute Teacher
challenges.method: base64 > hex > Vigenere cipher.

challenges.title: Backwards
challenges.method: zsteg > reverse > base64 > reverse > hex > reverse > flag.

challenges.title: Ret3Win
challenges.method: Buffer overflow over netcat (ret2win): place the address just after the win function so you jump into win with no segfault.

challenges.title: All Roads Lead to Flags
challenges.method: Split the GIF frames > Roman numerals > ASCII codes > flag.

challenges.title: Fragile Lock
challenges.method: Obfuscated JavaScript: remove the lock to reveal the flag.

challenges.title: Sheeeesh
challenges.method: Obfuscated Java that encodes a flag; decode it.
challenges.prompt: I found this flag but it appears to have been encrypted by a gen-alpha coder.

challenges.title: Server-Side PDF
challenges.method: PDF-image vulnerability; bypass networking with a domain that resolves and 302-redirects to a localhost URL.

challenges.title: Magic Number
challenges.method: Fix/read the PNG magic bytes.

challenges.title: Double Canary
challenges.method: Defeat a double stack canary.
